strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: the morning puffy face, the lost jawline on photos · cause: inflamed tissue holding fluid · tried: gua sha, ice rollers, less salt
strategy.belief_installed: A puffy face and soft jawline are fluid the body stopped moving, not weight.
